function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. • Keeps everything in place
• Versatile | • Can feel tight if too small
• May show through tight shirts | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug, waistband at hips | Work, casual, gym | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Less coverage
• Can feel restrictive | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, short or long leg | Sleep, lounging, casual | • Breathable

• Good support | • Less coverage than briefs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch, minimal fabric | Sports, high‑impact activities | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Not for everyday wear | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, full‑leg | Athletic performance, recovery | • Muscle support

• Hypoallergenic | • Can be pricier | | **Microfiber/Performance Blend** | Moisture‑wicking, quick‑dry | Hot climates, workouts | • Keeps dry

• Invisible under tight clothes | • Can be less durable | --- ## How to Pick the Right One 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity**: Boxers or loose briefs for breathability. - **High activity**: Compression shorts or jockstrap for support. - **Mixed**: Boxer briefs offer a good balance. 2. **Fit Matters Most** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist, not too tight or too loose. - **Leg length**: For boxer briefs/trunks, the leg should reach just above the knee for most men; longer legs can be more comfortable for taller individuals. - **Pouch**: A well‑designed pouch provides support and reduces friction. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but can absorb moisture. - **Polyester/Spandex blends**: Stretchy, moisture‑wicking, great for workouts. - **Bamboo**: Naturally antibacterial, very soft. - **Merino wool**: Keeps warm in cold, cool in hot, odor‑resistant. 4. **Lifestyle & Wardrobe** - **Under tight shirts**: Boxer briefs or trunks keep lines smooth. - **Under loose shirts**: Boxers or briefs work fine. - **Travel**: Quick‑dry, wrinkle‑resistant fabrics are a plus. 5. **Budget & Longevity** - **High‑end brands** (e.g., Calvin Klein, Tommy John, Saxx) often use premium fabrics and have better construction, but you can find quality options from brands like Hanes, Fruit of the Loom, or Uniqlo for lower prices. - **Durability**: Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and leg seams. --- ## Top Picks (2026) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Tommy John** | Ultra‑Comfort Boxer Briefs | Soft micro‑cotton, no‑punch pouch, great for all‑day wear. | | **Saxx** | Vibe Boxer Briefs | Built‑in support pouch, breathable mesh, anti‑odor. | | **Uniqlo** | AIRism Boxer Briefs | Ultra‑thin, moisture‑wicking, affordable. | | **Calvin Klein** | Classic Briefs | Iconic fit, smooth waistband, timeless look. | | **MeUndies** | Microfiber Boxers | Soft, stretchy, wide range of colors. | | **Bamboo Body** | Bamboo Boxer Briefs | Eco‑friendly, hypoallergenic, breathable. | | **Under Armour** | HeatGear Compression Shorts | Great for high‑intensity workouts, quick‑dry. | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need a pouch?** | For most men, yes—provides support and reduces friction. | | **Can I wear boxers all day?** | Yes, if you’re comfortable with less support and more airflow. | | **What’s the best fabric for hot climates?** | Moisture‑wicking blends (polyester/spandex) or bamboo. | | **How often should I replace underwear?** | Every 3–6 months, or sooner if you notice wear or odor. | | **Can I wear underwear under a suit?** | Boxer briefs or briefs are best to avoid visible lines. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort and support**: Boxer briefs or briefs. - **For maximum breathability**: Boxers or bamboo fabrics. - **For athletic performance**: Compression shorts or jockstrap. - **For a fashion statement**: Trunks or designer briefs. Pick the style that matches your daily routine, body shape, and personal preference. Once you find the right fit, you’ll notice a big difference in comfort and confidence. Happy shopping!
